not_for: Those looking strictly for slide design (see Presentation Skills)
Beginners struggling with basic English fluency
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Individuals who need grammar or basic fluency training.

prerequisites.required: Comfortable holding a basic conversation in English.
prerequisites.recommended: Willingness to speak on camera and receive critique.

overview.positioning: Conquer stage fright and command any room with powerful public speaking skills.
overview.short_description: An intensive specialization focused purely on the art of speaking to groups. Learn to manage anxiety, engage crowds, speak extemporaneously, and handle Q&A sessions.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Manage speaking anxiety and channel nervous energy.
Deliver speeches without relying heavily on notes.
Engage and interact with live audiences.
Think on your feet during Q&A and impromptu speaking.

why_now.industry_shift: As automation increases, human skills like persuasion, motivation, and leadership speaking are highly valued.
why_now.ai_impact: AI cannot replicate the charisma, empathy, and energy of a live speaker.
why_now.business_demand: Companies need spokespeople who can represent their brand confidently.
why_now.career_opportunity: Public speaking is consistently ranked as a top skill for executive promotion.

learning_outcomes: COMMAND: The stage (physical or virtual) with executive presence.
DELIVER: Speeches clearly, passionately, and persuasively.
OVERCOME: Stage fright and performance anxiety.
IMPROVISE: Responses to unexpected questions or situations.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Speaking to a live virtual audience.

supporting_tools.purpose: Analyzing speech pace and filler words

industry_workflow.overview: The process of preparing and delivering a speech.

stages.name: Mental Conditioning
stages.desc: Managing nerves before taking the stage.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Leaders failing to inspire teams during all-hands meetings.
business_use_cases.approach: Training in vocal modulation and persuasive storytelling.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Tracking filler words (um, ah) via transcripts.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Reading the audience's mood and adjusting delivery.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Use AI to analyze performance, not script every word.

best_practices: Embrace the pause instead of using filler words.
Focus on serving the audience, not on your own performance.

common_mistakes.professional_approach: Memorize concepts and structure, allowing the exact words to flow naturally.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Can represent the company publicly with poise and authority.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: Video recordings of various speech types.

assessment.model: Peer and instructor critique of video submissions and live deliveries.
assessment.criteria: Confidence, clarity, engagement, and handling of pressure.

certification.title: Specialist in Public Speaking
certification.criteria: Successful delivery of the final keynote and passing impromptu exercises.

faq.question: I have terrible stage fright. Will this help?
faq.answer: Yes, module 1 is entirely dedicated to psychological and physical techniques for managing speaking anxiety.

faq.question: Do I need an audience to practice?
faq.answer: You will practice live with your peers via Zoom to simulate a real audience.

modules.module_purpose: Understand and manage the physical and mental symptoms of anxiety.

lessons.what_is_taught: Why we fear speaking and how adrenaline affects the body.
lessons.why_it_matters: Understanding the biology helps demystify the fear.
lessons.what_learner_does: Journaling exercise on personal speaking fears.

lessons.what_is_taught: Diaphragmatic breathing, posture, and muscle relaxation.
lessons.why_it_matters: Calms the nervous system before and during a speech.
lessons.what_learner_does: Practice breathing exercises before a short recording.
lessons.expected_outcome: Tools to reduce physical symptoms of stress.

lessons.why_it_matters: Takes the pressure off being perfect.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deliver a 1-minute low-stakes speech on a passionate topic.

modules.assignment: Submit a 2-minute video on 'Why I want to improve my speaking', focusing on relaxed breathing.
modules.expected_outcome: Reduced anxiety and better emotional control.

modules.module_purpose: Use your voice and body to command attention.

lessons.why_it_matters: Silence projects confidence; filler words project uncertainty.
lessons.what_learner_does: Record a speech, analyze with Otter.ai for fillers, and re-record.

lessons.what_is_taught: Adjusting volume, pitch, and speed to maintain interest.
lessons.why_it_matters: Monotone delivery is the fastest way to lose an audience.
lessons.what_learner_does: Read a text using extreme variations in voice, then find a natural balance.

lessons.what_is_taught: Purposeful hand gestures and 'anchoring' on stage (or in frame).
lessons.why_it_matters: Random movement distracts; purposeful movement emphasizes.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deliver a speech focusing solely on coordinated hand gestures.

modules.assignment: Submit a 3-minute video demonstrating vocal variety and purposeful pausing.
modules.business_application: Holding attention in long meetings or conferences.

modules.module_purpose: Learn to think on your feet and handle unexpected situations.

lessons.what_is_taught: PREP (Point, Reason, Example, Point) for quick structuring.
lessons.why_it_matters: Prevents rambling when put on the spot.
lessons.what_learner_does: Answer random prompt questions using PREP.

lessons.what_is_taught: Repeating questions, bridging, and dealing with hostile questions.
lessons.why_it_matters: Q&A can make or break a speaker's credibility.

lessons.what_is_taught: What to do when you lose your train of thought.
lessons.why_it_matters: Mistakes happen; recovery is what matters.
lessons.what_learner_does: Practice recovery phrases ('Let me take a step back...').

modules.assignment: Participate in a live impromptu speaking session graded by the instructor.
modules.business_application: Excelling in media interviews, panels, and unscripted meetings.

modules.module_purpose: Prepare and deliver a polished, extended presentation.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using mind maps and bullet points instead of full scripts.
lessons.what_learner_does: Create a speech outline using only 10 keywords.
lessons.expected_outcome: Ability to speak from concepts, not scripts.

lessons.what_is_taught: Asking rhetorical questions, eye contact scanning, and reading the room.
lessons.what_learner_does: Incorporate 3 interaction techniques into their final speech draft.

lessons.what_is_taught: Bringing together mindset, vocal variety, body language, and structure.

modules.hands_on_practice: Rehearsing and refining the final speech.
modules.assignment: Deliver a 10-minute keynote speech (live on Zoom or recorded via Loom).
modules.business_application: Delivering major presentations, town halls, or conference talks.
